mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and aminoglycosides like tobramycin exhibit enhanced nephrotoxicity when combined with beta-lactams; cephalosporins may increase aminoglycoside renal accumulation and ototoxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and tobramycin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative agents if possible; assess baseline and ongoing renal function and hearing.
